BJP Leaders Increase Instagram Use After PM's Digital Outreach Call

Following Prime Minister Narendra Modi's directive for increased digital engagement, leaders of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) have significantly amplified their activity on Instagram. This surge in social media presence is particularly noted in their campaign efforts related to the NEET paper leak issue. The initiative aims to enhance the party's outreach and communication through digital platforms.
